description: This source file defines the 'Developer' controller class within the OpenCart admin module. It provides various administrative functionalities such as clearing HTML cache, clearing system cache, deleting themes, generating SASS files, and regenerating vendor autoloaders. The methods heavily rely on specific OpenCart system functions, models, and conventions to manipulate cache, files, and tasks.
external_files: common/developer.php (the view template referenced in code)

classes.name: Developer
classes.description: Controller class for managing developer operations such as cache clearing, theme refresh, SASS regeneration, and vendor autoloading within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main developer view with user token.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Deletes HTML view files in the catalog view directory if the user has modify permissions and returns JSON status.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Deletes cache files in the cache directory if the user has modify permissions and returns JSON status.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Deletes theme cache directories if permissions are sufficient and returns JSON status.

methods.name: sass_catalog
methods.description: Queues a task to regenerate catalog SASS files if the SASS file exists and permissions are correct, then returns JSON status.

methods.name: sass_admin
methods.description: Queues a task to regenerate admin SASS files if the SASS file exists and permissions are correct, then returns JSON status.

methods.name: vendor
methods.description: Generates a PHP autoload file for Composer packages found in vendor directories if permissions are met, then returns JSON status.
